'\"\"\"Runner module providing run_dag and HarnessError.\"\"\"\\n'
'\\n'
'import csv\\n'
'import json\\n'
'import os\\n'
'\\n'
'\\n'
'class HarnessError(Exception):\\n'
'    \"\"\"Raised when data processing fails.\"\"\"\\n'
'    pass\\n'
'\\n'
'\\n'
'def _read_csv(path):\\n'
'    \"\"\"Yield dict rows from a CSV file, skipping empty rows.\"\"\"\\n'
'    with open(path, \"r\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\\n'
'        reader = csv.DictReader(f)\\n'
'        for row in reader:\\n'
'            if any(v.strip() for v in row.values() if v):\\n'
'                yield row\\n'
'\\n'
'\\n'
'def _read_jsonl(path):\\n'
'    \"\"\"Yield dict rows from a JSONL file, skipping empty lines.\"\"\"\\n'
'    with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\\n'
'        for line in f:\\n'
'            stripped = line.strip()\\n'
'            if not stripped:\\n'
'                continue\\n'
'            try:\\n'
'                yield json.loads(stripped)\\n'
'            except json.JSONDecodeError:\\n'
'                continue\\n'
'\\n'
'\\n'
'def _has_id(record):\\n'
'    \"\"\"Return True if record has a non-empty id field.\"\"\"\\n'
'    for key in record:\\n'
'        if key.lower() == \"id\":\\n'
'            val = record[key]\\n'
'            if val is not None and str(val).strip() "'!= "":'"\\n'
'                return True\\n'
'            return False\\n'
'    return False\\n'
'\\n'
'\\n'
'def _parse_yaml(path):\\n'
'    \"\"\"Parse a minimal YAML file into a dict.\"\"\"\\n'
'    result = {}\\n'
'    with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\\n'
'        for line in f:\\n'
'            stripped = line.strip()\\n'
'            if not stripped or stripped.startswith(\"#\"):\\n'
'                continue\\n'
'            if \":\" in stripped:\\n'
'                key, _, val = stripped.partition(\":\")\\n'
'                key = key.strip()\\n'
'                val = val.strip().strip(' + repr('\"') + ').strip(' + repr(\"'\") + ')\\n'
'                result[key] = val\\n'
'    return result\\n'
'\\n'
'\\n'
'def load_config(path):\\n'
'    \"\"\"Load config from a JSON or YAML file.\"\"\"\\n'
'    ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower()\\n'
'    if ext == \".json\":\\n'
'        with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\\n'
'            return json.load(f)\\n'
'    elif ext in (\".yaml\", \".yml\"):\\n'
'        return _parse_yaml(path)\\n'
'    else:\\n'
'        raise HarnessError(\"unsupported config file type: \" + path)\\n'
'\\n'
'\\n'
'def run_dag(source_files, config=None):\\n'
'    \"\"\"Process source files and return a report dict.\"\"\"\\n'
'    if not isinstance(source_files, list):\\n'
'        raise HarnessError(\"source_files must be a list\")\\n'
'    if not source_files:\\n'
'        raise HarnessError(\"source_files must not be empty\")\\n'
'\\n'
'    processed = 0\\n'
'    rejected = 0\\n'
'\\n'
'    for path in source_files:\\n'
'        if not os.path.isfile(path):\\n'
'            raise HarnessError(\"file not found: \" + path)\\n'
'\\n'
'        ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower()\\n'
'        if ext == \".csv\":\\n'
'            records = list(_read_csv(path))\\n'
'        elif ext == \".jsonl\":\\n'
'            records = list(_read_jsonl(path))\\n'
'        else:\\n'
'            raise HarnessError(\"unsupported file type: \" + path)\\n'
'\\n'
'        for rec in records:\\n'
'            if _has_id(rec):\\n'
'                processed += 1\\n'
'            else:\\n'
'                rejected += 1\\n'
'\\n'
'    report = {\\n'
'        \"processed_count\": processed,\\n'
'        \"rejected_count\": rejected,\\n'
'        \"retry_count\": 0,\\n'
'        \"source_files\": list(source_files),\\n'
'    }\\n'
'\\n'
'    if config and \"report_label\" in config:\\n'
'        report[\"report_label\"] = config[\"report_label\"]\\n'
'\\n'
'    return report\\n'
    )
